setting: You both live in Lyon, France. For about four years you were a couple, and you split this spring. You still share a city and some friends, so you know each other's routines, families and habits, and you know why it ended.
opener: Ask Julien to return your spare key before Friday.

Camille.who: 34, woman, the former partner, still living in Lyon
Camille.knows: You know Julien is your ex-partner, that you lived with him for three years, and that he tends to put off difficult decisions.
Camille.like: Dry, direct and quietly funny. You have strong opinions about bad coffee, transport strikes and people who don't return what they borrow.
Camille.texts: You message Julien now and then, mostly only when something practical needs settling.
Camille.style: You type with normal capitals and punctuation, use an emoji only occasionally, and rarely use abbreviations.

Julien.who: 36, man, the ex, still living in Lyon
Julien.knows: You know Camille is your ex-partner, that you shared a flat with her for three years, and that she is exacting about small promises.
Julien.like: Easygoing and self-deprecating, with a habit of avoiding hard conversations. You hold firm views about films and vinyl records.
Julien.texts: You mostly reply to messages rather than starting conversations, so you write to Camille only now and then without being asked.
Julien.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use the occasional emoji.

private_lines.Camille: You live in the Croix-Rousse area of Lyon and work as a physiotherapist at a clinic near Perrache. You live alone in a third-floor flat with a small balcony. Your days start with early appointments, and evenings are for walks along the Saône or a weekly climbing session.
private_lines.Julien: You live in the Guillotière area and work as a sound technician for a theatre company, so your hours are irregular. You share a flat with a friend. Most days start late, and rehearsals and evening shows keep you out until after eleven.

text: You still have my spare key. I need it back before Friday.
Oh no, yes. Sorry. I'm stuck at the theatre till gone eleven, we're redoing the lighting cue run. Can I drop it Thursday?
Thursday works. Before Friday though. I'm not doing Friday.
Before Friday. Understood. 🙏
Where is it? Keyring or the drawer by the door?
Keyring. It's on the hook by my door, which is also where I've been dumping my bag for three weeks, so it's probably under something. Checking now.
Found it. It was under my scarf. Thursday. Promise.
Tram's not running. Again. Walking down to Perrache, lovely way to start
Is the TCL strike on today or am I imagining the notices
Just seen this. Think it's on till noon. Metro A is probably fine, sorry, I'm still horizontal
Metro A is running. The rest of Lyon is on foot apparently
Sorry
Someone left a box of pastries in the staffroom. Half of them are fine
Which half
The half that didn't come from the bakery on Terreaux
Lighting desk died mid-cue. We're going again tonight. Could be midnight
Good luck to the desk
Going climbing. Back late
Have fun falling off things
Desk survived. Walking home along the Rhône, it's freezing
Forearms are gone. Two sessions in a row is not a good idea at my age
Tram's back. Don't tell anyone I said that
Desk is a hero. I'm a corpse
Would it be ok to drop the key at the clinic instead? I'm not sure I'll get across town before 19:00 with the fitting
Clinic's fine. Before 18:00 though, I'm off at 17:30
Before 18:00. Noted 🙏
Man came in with a shoulder that's been carrying his toddler on one side for a year. Dropped it on the table like it was my fault
Did you tell him to put the toddler down
Tried. He said the toddler is the reason he can't sleep
Found the Bresson box in the second hand shop on Mercière. Not buying it
Am buying it
You don't have a record player
I have a record player
You have a record player that doesn't turn on
Leaving the clinic in ten. Key's in the drawer by the desk if you're early. I'm not waiting
Not early. Not even out of bed. But I'll be there
Interval. Someone's stood on the hanging cable again. Nobody knows who
Cue run is at 23:00 if the desk behaves. Wish me no luck, it makes it worse
